lines.arrive: A waiting room. You and Jones have both applied for the same job.
lines.told: The president has told you himself: Jones will get the job.
lines.counted: And you've just watched Jones count the coins in his pocket. Ten.
lines.window: Round green hills, in tidy rows, all the way to the sky.
lines.concluded: So. The man who gets the job has ten coins in his pocket.
lines.waited: You don't draw any conclusions. You just wait your turn.
lines.twist: You got the job. Not Jones.
lines.yours: And in your own pocket: ten coins. You never counted them.
lines.end: You believed it. It was true. You had good reason. But it was true of the wrong man. Did you know it?
lines.yours_2: Ten coins in your own pocket. You never counted them.
lines.end_2: It's true, now, that the man who got the job has ten coins in his pocket. You just never believed it.
